expectations.evidence: Commands, paths, the 2-minute drain and the 90-day/14-day figures all come from the original, and the rollback `sudo cp /etc/billing/tls/previous.pem /etc/billing/tls/current.pem` plus restart does what the original describes; the only additions are minor wording such as "on Slack" and "Verify the certificate is loaded".
Step 2 runs `sudo cp .../current.pem .../previous.pem` before the step 4 swap, and the step 6 failure path copies previous.pem back to current.pem and restarts billing-worker.
The Vault-move history and the manual-per-box background are dropped, and the steps contain only commands with one-line notes such as "This takes up to 2 minutes."

The VPN/role and month-end warnings sit under Prerequisites before the steps, the backup (step 2) precedes the swap (step 4), and each numbered step has one action; the only ambiguity is whether to run step 7 after a rollback.
